messages:
Lucy Martin: Morning team! I'm Lucy — starting on Platform Eng today. Excited to be here. I'm remote in PST. Quick setup Qs: VPN & MDM enrollment steps? Also who to ping for GCP access? Coffee preference: oat latte. Two truths & a lie: I can juggle, climbed Kilimanjaro, allergic to coffee. :wave:
Priya Rao: Welcome Lucy!! I'm your onboarding buddy — ping me anytime. VPN: follow the 'Get Access' page (https://intranet.redwood/get-access) and install WireGuard. For MDM, open the MDM app we emailed and enter the 6-digit code. I'll DM you the exact link. :tada:
Tom (IT): Hey Lucy — laptop has been assigned (asset R-3421) and should arrive today. MDM enrollment: open System Settings -> Profiles -> Enroll and paste the code Priya sends. If you hit the error "device not eligible" paste the error here. VPN: once WireGuard installed, import the profile I pushed to your email and run `wg-quick up redwood`.
DevX Bot: account-created: GitHub org invite sent, Okta invite pending approval from SSO-admin, Slack welcome DM queued.
Kai Ramirez: welcome!! Heads-up: Platform sync is Tue/Thu 9:30am PST. If you want a mechanical keyboard rec, we have a small keyboard channel. Also, we do a slack demo on Wednesdays for new folks.
Lucy Martin: Thanks all — super helpful. Small follow-up: how do I request a second monitor and access to the 'model-serving' GCP project?
Samir: For hardware, fill out the form at https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request (choose "monitor" -> priority "new hire"). For GCP access, file an infra request and tag Felipe in the ticket. I'll drop a starter command for local inference in a sec.
Felipe Lopez: Granting GCP role now (you should get an email). For projects, we need your corporate email and the ticket ID — Samir, feel free to forward.
Samir: Local inference quickstart: clone repo, then `./scripts/run_local.sh --model redwood-mini --input samples/hello.json`. If you see an OOM, try `--batch 1 --seq-len 512`. If you want to test latency locally, run `./scripts/bench.py --model redwood-mini --iters 20`.
Tom (IT): FYI MDM tip — if the enrollment fails, open Console.app -> Profiles -> remove old profile, reboot, try again. If WireGuard fails, send the `wg show` output (scrub IPs if needed).
Priya Rao: Also, we'll add you to the #platform-private channel and the onboarding doc with links to runbooks. When you have a minute, drop a 1-paragraph intro in #general (fun facts appreciated!). :coffee:
Lucy Martin: Will do — thanks again everyone! Fun fact: I played in a jazz trio for 5 years (saxophone). Okay maybe the coffee allergy is the lie. :saxophone: :coffee:
